approvedBy: Claude editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-28
firstPlayerRule: To decide who goes first, each player in turn rolls all 5 dice. The player with the highest total goes first. Play then passes to the left.
houseFallback: If two or more players tie for the highest total, this site's house-rule fallback is to have just the tied players roll again until one is highest.
clarifications: This is the roll-off used only to decide who goes first; it is separate from each player's own turn, where they roll up to 3 times to fill a scoring category.
internalEvidence: Fetched the official Hasbro-hosted PDF (hasbro.com/common/instruct/yahtzee.pdf) and read it directly. Page 1, "How to Play": "Each player takes a score card. To decide who goes first, each player in turn rolls all 5 dice. The player with the highest total goes first. Play then passes to the left." Page 8 credits: "Milton Bradley Company, P.O. Box 1247, East Longmeadow, MA 01028. ©1996 Milton Bradley Company. All Rights Reserved. E0950." No tie-break for the roll-off is stated in the document.
uncertainty: The document does not state a tie-break procedure if two or more players roll the same highest total; the house fallback above is this site's own suggestion, not the publisher's.
